name: middleleap-ai-dlc
description: MiddleLeap AI DLC — downloadable content for AI-enabled development: skills, agents, and workflows for regulated software delivery.

plugins.name: middleleap-loom
plugins.description: The Loom — MiddleLeap's method for building regulated software with AI: a gated discovery harness, an autonomous delivery loop with human four-eyes merge, always-on guardrails, the machinery to adopt it in any repository, and the CLAUDE.md authoring and code-review kit it runs on. Installs the UAE banking, UAE Open Finance and Meridian Trust demo plugins with it. Proven end-to-end on a UAE Open Finance back office.

plugins.name: middleleap-banking-uae
plugins.description: UAE banking expertise for CBUAE-regulated institutions — a virtual Head of Risk (UAE and international variants: discovery, backlog risk tagging, formal review, control-automation verification), Islamic banking (Shariah-compliant finance), and New Product Approval (the Business Proposition Form, the CBUAE anchor behind each field, sign-off routing). General-purpose: works with or without the Loom.

plugins.name: middleleap-open-finance-uae
plugins.description: UAE Open Finance domain expertise — CBUAE regulation and Standards errata tracking, Al Tareq platform integration, AlTareq brand and CX requirements, and value-proposition prototyping.

plugins.name: middleleap-loom-demo
plugins.description: The Loom demo institution — Meridian Trust, a fictional CBUAE-regulated bank, packaged as an institution pack: its brand guidelines (palette, type, slide layout, logos) and its capital-approval business case (ISB pre-screening, CIC detailed case, NPV model, sign-offs). Shows how an institution's own context plugs into the Loom's discovery → delivery gate; retarget it to a real bank by swapping the values.
